criteria.criterion: vloop brief check reads the repository's .vloop/repo-guidelines.md when it exists; under `## Pinning tests` each line of the form - when `<phrase>`: `<name>`, `<name>`… is a rule; names are read before a trailing parenthesis, so a rule ending `(D20261011-1455)` has no extra name; other lines, and malformed lines, are ignored
criteria.evidence: internal/brief/pinning.go pinningRules/parsePinRule; strict parse, trailing ' (' accepted; TestPinningMalformedLinesIgnoredAndNeverAProblem and TestPinningMissingNamesInRuleOrder

criteria.criterion: For each rule whose phrase the brief's Behaviour contract section contains (case-insensitive plain substring) and whose names the Constraints section does not all contain (plain substrings), one warning: `must-change list: the contract mentions "<phrase>" but Constraints do not name <name>, <name> (.vloop/repo-guidelines.md)`, the missing names in the rule's order
criteria.evidence: pinning.go pinningLines lowercases contract, plain strings.Contains, missing names in rule order; exact message asserted in TestPinningMissingNamesInRuleOrder

criteria.criterion: Sections are found by the repository's heading set (B-3) and run through their ### subsections to the next ## heading; a rule never reads the whole brief (B-4). Violation: a rule read from the whole brief rather than its named section
criteria.evidence: HeadingSet.BehaviourContract added for en/es; sectionText reads only the named ## section through ### to the next ##; tests for subsections, phrase outside contract, Spanish brief

criteria.criterion: With no guidelines file, or one with no such section or lines, the output is exactly today's
criteria.evidence: pinningLines returns nil when no rules; TestPinningNoFileNoSectionNoWarning; gate compares against base binary output

criteria.criterion: The warning never becomes a problem and never changes brief check's exit code. Violation: a warning that becomes a problem, or changes the exit code
criteria.evidence: lines appended with Warning marker in check.go; test asserts r.Failed() is false

criteria.criterion: No regular expressions in the file: phrases and names match as plain substrings; the file is read from the repository root, never HOME
criteria.evidence: pinning.go uses strings.Contains/Cut and filepath.Join(root, GuidelinesFile); no regexp in the file (heading regex is the existing helper in check.go)

criteria.criterion: Committed tests (internal/brief) cover the worked example's cases: the missing names in rule order, all named, the phrase outside the contract, no file, a malformed line, a Spanish brief; and the real-data check (four consumed briefs warn naming the tests their defects say they omitted) holds. Violation: the behaviour shipped with no committed test the checks run
criteria.evidence: internal/brief/pinning_test.go covers all six cases; the real-data check is exercised by the T4 gate, which the driver passed

criteria.criterion: No earlier test is weakened: only the tests the brief's Constraints list change, and only as they state
criteria.evidence: git diff HEAD touches only check.go and headings.go plus new pinning files; no existing test file modified; go check passed

notes: The real-data check lives only in the gate; no committed test copies the four consumed briefs (the work session says T13 closes that). Cosmetic: the pinRule doc comment has a stray quote character.
